# prime-cascadeselect

prime-rs: CascadeSelect component (PrimeNG port)

[Live demo](https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/cascadeselect) · [API docs](https://docs.rs/prime-cascadeselect) · [Port notes](https://github.com/anton-avramchuk/prime-rs/blob/HEAD/docs/cascadeselect.md)

CascadeSelect — port of `p-cascadeselect` from PrimeNG 21.1.10.

A field for picking a value from a nested structure: a panel with a root list, from which lists of
nested groups unfold sideways. Options are `CascadeOption` (a leaf with a value or a group with `children`), the value is a
two-way signal `RwSignal<Option<String>>` holding the value of the selected leaf.

```rust
use leptos::prelude::*;
use prime_cascadeselect::{CascadeOption, CascadeSelect};

let options = vec![CascadeOption::new("Australia").children(vec![CascadeOption::new("Sydney")])];
let value = RwSignal::new(Some("Sydney".to_owned()));
let html = Owner::new().with(|| view! { <CascadeSelect options=options value=value placeholder="Select" /> }.to_html());
assert!(html.contains("p-cascadeselect-label") && html.contains("Sydney") && !html.contains("p-cascadeselect-overlay"));
```

## Installation

```toml
[dependencies]
prime-cascadeselect = "0.1"
prime-theme = { version = "0.1", features = ["cascadeselect"] }
```

The component renders PrimeNG classes; its styles come from `prime-theme` (the Aura theme), one feature per component.
For server rendering enable the `ssr` feature in the server build and `hydrate` in the browser build.
Setting up an application (theme, SSR and hydration): https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/install
